summary: Chainlink CCIP 2.0 成为第一个在生产中使用快速确认规则（FCR）的跨链桥，从以太坊发起的转账可以比最终性快得多且仍有明确安全保证；Derek Chiang 说是 30 倍。ACDT #98 上，200M gas 上限在执行时间上被认为安全，FCR 将使用新的 confirmed 区块标签。Daisugi v0.2 支持 frame 交易，SPHINCS 签名的交易可以作为原生 frame 运行。

items.title: 新 EIP：重复调用递增 gas
items.note: （staccDOTsol，后编号 EIP-8429）。客户端在世界状态之外为地址维护引用计数，账户可一次性不可撤销地登记，之后对它的状态变更调用（不含 `STATICCALL`、`DELEGATECALL`）按两条递增曲线中较高者计价。
items.title_en: New EIP: escalating gas for repeated calls
items.note_en: (staccDOTsol, later EIP-8429). The client keeps a per-address reference counter outside world state; an account may enroll once, irrevocably, and state-changing calls into it (not `STATICCALL` or `DELEGATECALL`) are then priced on two ratchets, paying the larger.

keywords_en: Chainlink CCIP 2.0 first to ship FCR
EIP-8429 escalating gas for repeated calls
summary_en: Chainlink CCIP 2.0 became the first bridge to put the Fast Confirmation Rule (FCR) into production, so transfers originating from Ethereum can move much faster than finality with clear security guarantees; Derek Chiang put it at 30 times faster. At ACDT #98, the 200M gas limit was deemed safe on execution time, and FCR will use a new confirmed block tag. Daisugi v0.2 added frame transaction support, so SPHINCS-signed transactions can run as native frames.
